front.title: MispQL: A Query Language for Cyber Threat Intelligence

abstract.t: MispQL is a read-only, SQL-like query language for cyber threat intelligence (CTI). This document specifies its text syntax using Augmented Backus-Naur Form (ABNF), its query semantics, and a JSON representation for its Boolean filters. A CTI platform can implement MispQL over its own data model by describing the tables, fields, types, and operators it supports. A transport binding describes how the Python MispQL client uses the complex-search interface in MISP 3.0.
